CustomField.description: Opts a section into the review-mode state machine. When true, the section computes an `untouched` / `incomplete` / `complete` state and renders accordingly (expanded with badges in the first two states; collapsed with summary in the third when Auto_Collapse_When_Complete__c is also true).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Enables review-mode collapse for this section. Pair with Auto_Collapse_When_Complete__c and Summary_Template__c to control behaviour.
CustomField.label: Collapsible
